title: The Teacher
description: A patient instructor whose lessons turn confusion into a plan of action.

actions.name: Instruct
actions.effect: Give one ally a clear plan; the DM may grant +1 to the next relevant check.

hooks: A student has copied a dangerous symbol into their notebook.
The local school is built over a sealed ruin.
backstory: A travelling instructor collects local histories and teaches practical literacy along the road. The ongoing Teacher’s Quest has no recorded events yet; the teacher’s reasons for visiting Okla Deli remain open.
backstory_status: draft; no completed session events recorded
